test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **blessing****.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here, the author wants to say that being loved by someone is God's grace. Hence the correct answer is **blessing**.
 
• Great is an **adjective** and therefore, the next word must be a **noun** because a noun is qualified by an adjective. 

 Hence, **blessing** is the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
